title: 15 Steps To Success For An Affiliate Manager: Nurturing High-Potential Partnerships
summary: Dustin Howes walks through the 15-step journey an affiliate manager takes from finding a partner to replicating wins with them. His core claim is that time management is the biggest success metric: spend time nurturing high-potential partnerships and be patient while content ranks.

principles.text: Time management is the biggest success factor for an affiliate manager, not years of experience or revenue growth.
principles.quote: The biggest success metric is… Time Management.

principles.text: Spend your time nurturing high-potential partnerships; the hard part is execution.
principles.quote: The answer is easy: Spend time nurturing high potential partnerships. The execution is the hard part.

principles.text: Affiliate programs take time to build; they are not like paid ads that give instant results.
principles.quote: Affiliate programs are not grown overnight. You can’t just turn them on like Facebook ads and see instant results.

principles.text: Give affiliates everything they need to sell: free product, reviews, converting landing pages and earnings proof.
principles.quote: Set them up with free products and share other reviews with them that highlight great selling points. Show them which landing pages are converting best and share how much some of your affiliates are making.

principles.text: Be patient while affiliate content ranks; managers and executives must believe in the process.
principles.quote: Affiliate managers (and executives) need to be patient here and believe in the process.

principles.text: Once a partner is winning, replicate content with that same partner rather than starting from scratch.
principles.quote: Convincing someone with money in their pocket of doing more is a much easier conversation than starting from scratch.
